title: Lesson 34 - What Data Enhancement Means After Unification and the Insight Calculator Family
description: Demonstrate how to enhance data and build insights on unified data., focused on what enhancement means after harmonization and unification and on the family of calculators that build metrics: calculated insights, streaming insights, real-time insights, and data transforms.

questions.question: Which insight type processes high-volume batches of stored records to produce multidimensional metrics that segment criteria and personalization attributes can read?
questions.explanation: Calculated Insights run high-volume batches over stored data and publish measures and dimensions consumed by segments and personalization, while streaming and real-time insights work on engagement events.

questions.question: A team needs a rolling one-minute time series aggregation of Web SDK engagement events to trigger a data action. Which insight type fits?
questions.explanation: Streaming Insights aggregate near real-time engagement events over a rolling window and drive orchestration or data actions, while calculated insights are batch and a data transform shapes data rather than aggregating events.

questions.question: Which statement distinguishes Real-Time Insights from Streaming Insights?
options: Real-Time Insights compute results in milliseconds from each event that updates a real-time data graph
Real-Time Insights run only on mapped data lake object aggregations
Real-Time Insights are a type of copy field enrichment
questions.explanation: Real-time insights compute per event inside a real-time data graph with millisecond results, while streaming insights summarize a rolling window, and neither replaces identity resolution nor acts as an enrichment.
